about_the_game:
🧭 EXPLORE, SURVIVE, ESCAPE

  • Traverse eerie, handcrafted levels inspired by liminal spaces, abandoned infrastructure, and impossible architectures.

  • Play solo or in teams — co-op multiplayer supports up to 8 players.

  • Scavenge, decode, and survive as you search for clues, hidden gear, and the source of each branch’s corruption.

🔥 DESTROY THE BRANCH

Each operation centers around one critical objective:
✔ Find and eliminate the root of the branch - a core anomaly, corrupted entity, or source of instability.
✔ Close the rift before it mutates or consumes what's left.

Fail to shut it down and Somnium Corp will intervene… but your paycheck will take the hit.

🎯 OPTIONAL SIDE OBJECTIVES

While you’re inside the branch, you can earn extra credits by completing secondary contracts:
✔ Extract corrupted data from ancient terminals.
✔ Restore power to locked-down sectors.
✔ Contain anomalies before they multiply.
✔ Recover lost gear or locate missing operatives.

More risk = more reward. Just make it back to your pod in one piece.

🏠 CUSTOMIZABLE HUB & GEAR PROGRESSION

  • Upgrade your EchoStation, your home base between missions.

  • Trade with Solace, the enigmatic Somnium Corp AI, to unlock tools, enhancements, and better contracts.

  • Bring your loadout into the field — but die, and everything stored in your teleporter is lost.

name: Unreality: Beyond Worlds

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Close the rifts, survive the horrors beyond reality, and escape before the branch collapses. Unreality: Beyond Worlds is a multiplayer co-op survival horror where every contract is a fight against the unknown.
